Overview of DFCCIL HR Recruitment 2026

The Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) has released Vacancy Notice No. 44/2026, inviting applications for one post of Manager, Assistant Manager, or Junior Manager (HR) on a deputation basis. The position is located at the DFCCIL Corporate Office in Noida, Uttar Pradesh.

Serving officers and employees from Indian Railways, Central or State Governments, and Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) who meet the specified grade and experience criteria are eligible to apply through the proper channel.

Vacancy Details and Designation

  • Issuing Authority: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL)
  • Notification ID: Vacancy Notice No. 44/2026 (Dated: 28 October 2026)
  • Total Vacancies: 1 Post (Designation can be Manager, Assistant Manager, or Junior Manager based on the selected candidate's current grade)
  • Job Location: Corporate Office, Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  • Job Type: Central PSU Deputation (Initial duration of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years subject to DPE exemption rules)

Eligibility Criteria and Experience

Applicants must fulfill grade-specific requirements alongside a mandatory minimum of 5 years of work experience in the Personnel or HR department. Required functional experience covers selection, promotion, seniority, creation of posts, recruitment, transfer, disciplinary and court cases, service matters, grievances, settlement dues, and pay and allowances.

  • Manager: Group B (Gazetted) officers of Central/State Govt with at least 4 years in Group B in a relevant discipline, or PSU employees in an analogous grade or Rs. 60,000–1,800,000 (IDA) (E3) with 4 years in that grade.
  • Assistant Manager: Group B officers of Central/State Govt in a relevant discipline, or PSU employees in an analogous grade or Rs. 50,000–1,600,000 (IDA) (E2) with 4 years in that grade.
  • Junior Manager: Central/State Government employees in an analogous grade (Level-8) or holding substantive posts in Level-7 in a relevant discipline, or PSU employees in an analogous grade or Rs. 40,000–1,400,000 (IDA) (E1) with 4 years in that grade.
  • Age Limit: Maximum 55 years as of the closing date.
  • Cut-off Date: 27 November 2026 for age and eligibility calculations.

Fee and Salary Structure

  • Application Fee: Not specified in the official notification.
  • Salary: Selected candidates will receive their parent pay plus a deputation allowance, along with other perks and allowances applicable as per DFCCIL policy.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date: 28 October 2026
  • Application Closing Date: 27 November 2026

Selection Stages

  • Screening of applications received through the proper channel.
  • Verification of APARs for the last five years and Vigilance/D&AR clearance.
  • Note: No written examination or interview stage has been announced in the official notice.

How to Apply

  1. Download the official Vacancy Notice PDF containing the prescribed application proforma.
  2. Fill out the proforma completely and accurately.
  3. Secure No Objection Certificate (NOC), attested APAR ratings for the last five years (along with rating guidelines), and Vigilance/D&AR clearance through your parent organization.
  4. Superscribe the envelope with "Application for the Post of against Vacancy Notice No. 44/2026".
  5. Send the application via proper channel to:

General Manager (HR), DFCCIL Corporate Office Complex, Sector-145, Noida, Uttar Pradesh - 201306

  1. Ensure the application reaches the destination on or before 27 November 2026.

Verification and Official Links

Candidates must verify all criteria and download notifications directly from the official DFCCIL careers portal before submitting their documents. Avoid direct submissions without proper channels, as incomplete applications are subject to summary rejection.
